connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: Loop + and - are the sole interface and both are required. Optional: none in this abstract interface. Unmodeled: shield/drain, case bond, configuration and extra terminals. The 4-20 mA class is the type identity; measured quantity, range, supply voltage, compliance, load limits and ratings are unspecified. The author must select hardware and review loop power, polarity, input mode and compatibility. Logical +/- loop markings are not a manufacturer pinout. This nonconductive function does not join its two nets; the existing profile currently supports signal-loop views only.
